facts.business: International Data Management Limited is a listed company with fully eroded net worth and accumulated losses, currently dependent on promoter group financial support to continue as a going concern.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The Company has significant accumulated losses, incurred losses of Rs. 13.87 lakhs in current year and Rs. 12.83 lakhs in previous year, net worth fully eroded, current liabilities exceed current assets by Rs. 438.19 lakhs as at March 31, 2026. Financial statements prepared on going concern basis due to financial support from Promoter Group.
